runtime_statistic: median positive successful time per method and taxon count
speedup_statistic: median of comparator seconds / ConcordTree seconds on shared successfully timed record IDs, computed separately at each taxon count; pooled medians retained as metadata
limitations: DIPPER GPU uses the 900-input CUDA/TBB-preinitialized timing rerun with conversion included and one 16-thread worker per GPU; ConcordTree uses a retained engine. Other comparator hardware, thread counts, concurrency and timing boundaries remain historical and heterogeneous. Ratios describe recorded executions, not hardware-normalized algorithmic speedups. Partial coverage remains partial; missing and failed runs are excluded, never zero-filled.
